string-array.name: help_texts
string-array.item: Scrambled Net 2 is a simple puzzle game in which you sort out the connections in a computer network, so that all the terminals are connected to the server. The network is made up of tiles; they are all in the right place, but they have been randomly rotated into a useless mess.\n\nRotate individual tiles to re-connect the network. Tiles connected to the server are shown highlighted. When every terminal is connected, you win.

Touch a tile to rotate it clockwise. Press and hold a tile to lock it when you are sure it is correct, or to unlock it; locked tiles answer with a short click.\n\nDrag with one finger to pan the board, pinch with two fingers to zoom.

There are five levels of difficulty. Higher levels have larger boards, and the most advanced have special twists:

• Novice: a small board.

• Normal: a somewhat larger board.

• Expert: a large board.

• Master: a large board whose edges wrap around — a connection leaving the right edge enters the left edge, and likewise for the top and bottom edges.

• Insane: like Master, but all 3-way and 4-way tiles are invisible. You will need a whole new set of deductions to complete an insane puzzle.

Each win counts your clicks and your time, and your personal bests are kept for every skill level — but only if you solved the puzzle yourself: a game in which the auto-solver was used is never scored.\n\nSee “High scores” in the menu.

Work outwards from the server: confirmed tiles are your anchors, so lock them in as you go.

Tiles with a single connection are terminals — dead ends; aim them at the neighbour that needs them.

If you prefer a quiet board, you can switch the network animation off in the menu.
